text:
maya: Quick heads-up — PR #7134 (kv-cache: prefix-regen) is blocking the cut. Need 2x LGTM before 18:00 PT cutoff. Tests green in CI except one flake in integration/replication. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7134 :warning:

ci-bot: CI status — build ✅, unit tests ✅, integration ✅ (flaky-run1 failed), lint ✅, e2e skipped (tag: hotfix-short)

tom: I can take a look in ~20m. What's the risky part? Any DB migrations?

maya: No migrations. Change is small: KV cache regen logic + a defensive nil check. Main worry is timing around eviction under high concurrency.

oliver: I'll do a quick perf sanity: `make test-integration TESTS=kv_cache` locally then run `stress --concurrency 50 ./bin/kv_sanity` — should surface race.

sarah: heads down until 16:30 PT, can't review. If needed @linda can give the second sign-off.

linda: pinged. I'll review in 15 and prioritize if it's blocking the cut. If I find risky bits, can we delay merge window by 30m? /cc @release-bot

release-bot: Cutoff lock: 18:00 PT. Exceptions: critical security fixes only. Admin override required for window change.

maya: Thanks — if both reviews are clean I'll merge and monitor for 30m. If any integration flake persists, we can revert and roll forward the previous build.

tom: Found one nit and a small test assertion fix — pushing a tiny follow-up to the PR now. :thumbsup:

linda: Reviewed, LGTM. No blocking comments. :shipit:

maya: Thanks @tom @linda. Merging in 2m and promoting to canary region. Will post rollout status.

ci-bot: Merge complete — merged by maya at 2018765625. Canary deploy started (region: us-west-2-canary).

oliver: I'll watch the canary logs for 30m; set up an alert if error-rate > 0.5% for kv endpoints.

maya: Deployed and monitoring. Will update status in #incidents if anything spikes. :rocket:
